methods: Hashed immutable original PDFs/DOCs, source story exports, author component files and relevant authenticated parent ledgers before review.
Independently rendered all 28 images from original PDFs at declared scales/crop boxes and compared pixels to author evidence; all match.
Actually emitted and inspected every independent rerender with view_image; the full pages and localized crops are separately enumerated in page_observations.jsonl.
Compared literal character transcriptions, exact raw CP slices, every appendix row/cell, page continuations, empty critic cells and printed anomalies.
Recomputed selected glyph draws from original PDFs and re-extracted original font bytes/outlines; inspected actual Bengali font resource and GSUB rules.
Checked exact correction before-states against parent ledgers and derived every after transcription using only unchanged source plus exact inherited display mappings.

source_claim_limits: Appendix title, weak-grade labels and named critic/narrator cells are edition claims. This review performs no independent grading, narrator identification, chain authentication or canonical numbering reconciliation.
Appendix quotation cells with ellipses are excerpts; no complete-matn certification is made.
Graphic logo fields, nonprinting DOC controls and the raw source text remain distinct from visible transcriptions.

The 13 localized completions rely on inherited whole-page reviews outside the independently inspected target crops. Broader after-transcriptions were mechanically checked against exact source/inherited mappings, not visually reread in full.
integration_handoff: Apply only the reviewed exact before/after overlays and preserve the author component bytes/hashes. This pass covers the bound component evidence. A separate reviewer must verify final merged candidate bytes and any broader claims.
